chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from a man, from Abu Abdullah ibn 'Umayr, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), said:

I said, 'At what age is a girl no longer considered a child (pre-pubescent)? Is it a girl of six or seven?' He (peace be upon him) said, 'No, it is a girl of nine who is no longer considered a child, and all of them have formed a consensus upon that a girl of nine is no longer considered a child, except if there happens to be a weakness in her intellect, or else, so when she reaches nine (years), she has reached puberty.'
ai.seo_question: What is the age of puberty for girls according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the foundational Shia juristic consensus (ijma') that nine lunar years constitutes the standard age of puberty (bulugh) for girls, marking the onset of legal responsibility (taklif). It introduces a crucial scholarly nuance: while nine is the default threshold, intellectual immaturity ('aql) can serve as an exception, delaying full legal maturity until cognitive capacity is established. This principle underscores the Shia emphasis on both physical and mental readiness in determining religious obligations.

en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I said, ‘The girl, when would she not be reckoned as a child, a girl of six or seven (years of age)?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, it is a girl of nine who would not be reckoned as a child, and all of them have formed a consensus upon that a girl of nine would not be reckoned as a child except if there happens to be a weakness in her intellect, or else, so when she reaches nine (years), so she has reached puberty’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from a man who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘When is a girl not considered a child? Is it a girl who is six or seven years old?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘No, a nine-year-old girl is not considered a child and all of them are unanimous that a girl who is nine years old is not considered a child unless there is weakness in her reason, otherwise, when she becomes nine years old she becomes mature.’”
